title: typing-indicators/1.0/typing
description: The sender is typing a message in this conversation now. Holds until expires_time, or until a message from the sender arrives in the conversation. Delivered live or not at all.

id.description: Message ID, unique to the sender; the same id goes to every member of a group. Each re-send while typing continues has a new id.

from.description: Sender DID. Always present: these messages are sent authenticated, and the envelope, not the body, says who sent them.

pthid.description: In a group conversation, the group's id. Absent in a pair.

thid.description: When the sender is typing in a thread (chat-threads/1.0), the thread's id. Otherwise absent.

expires_time.description: UTC epoch seconds, about 10 and at most 30 seconds after created_time. The indicator is shown until then; the same value goes on every routing/2.0/forward wrapping this message, so that a mediator drops it rather than queue or push it.

body.description: Empty in this version. A receiver ignores any field it finds.
